answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and tie that stake to a verifiable history of completed work rather than a free username. A flood of fake identities then faces a real cost: like a tide, cheap copies arrive quickly, but each one must pay the same bond and build the same record. Reputation spreads like a vine only through attested jobs, so a single operator cannot echo one good record across dozens of shells without funding every copy and risking every bond when fraud is proven.
